extDescription.message: Levels out loud and quiet passages on a page, so dialogue stays audible without explosions blowing your ears off. Remembered per site.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the store and the extensions page

enable.description: Button that turns compression on for this site

disable.description: Button that turns compression off for this site

knob_holdAboveDb.description: Knob: dB above the programme loudness where compression and levelling start

knob_reachBelowDb.description: Knob: dB below the programme loudness that levelling reaches down to

programme.description: Label before the measured programme loudness in dBFS

unavailable.message: This page's audio is protected and cannot be processed
unavailable.description: Shown when every audio source is DRM-protected or CORS-tainted

noAudio.message: No audio detected on this page
noAudio.description: Shown when the page has no audio source at all
